title: 2 <= e, by an EVENTUAL argument
statement: le two e -- the first numeric bound on Euler's number. Needs an EVENTUAL argument (converges_lower_bound_shift), NOT converges_lower_bound directly: expSeriesPartial 0 = 0 < 2, so the bound does not hold at index 0 and only holds from index 2 on, where monotonicity of the nonnegative-summand partial sums (sumRange_mono_outer at expTerm) takes over and expSeriesPartial 2 reduces, by Kernel::def_eq, to the same Rat.mk normal form as the literal two.
